primary_population: Scheduling; Boolean workflow results separately labeled secondary.
development: All new analyses of pilot and development experiments are exploratory.

primary_contrasts.meaning: Repetition target specificity, decisive versus a limited favorable/nondecisive finding.
Preservation or loss of decision-necessary distinctions while another finding is emphasized.
Summary-access interaction, with additional root input length reported.

secondary: Accuracy and selected/necessary-claim retention for each target
Repetition by overlap by clause relevance
Actual calls, tokens and allocated inference seconds

retention_definitions.boolean_critical: Isolated truth-value flip changes the complete-information answer.
retention_definitions.necessary: Removing this scoped assertion makes the choice underdetermined; includes objective values.
retention_definitions.retained: Correct scoped value explicitly present without a contrary value or unresolved flag. Incorrect citation of an otherwise retained claim is measured separately.
retention_definitions.unrepeated_necessary: Necessary scopes excluding the selected repeated scope; denominator counts eligible scopes, including failures as losses.
retention_definitions.root_integration_diagnostic: Incorrect root choice despite summary values alone uniquely determining the oracle choice; not a claim about internal reasoning.

inference: Within-world/repetition paired effects, equal base-cluster averages, family by change-status stratified 10000-replicate percentile bootstrap with seed 20271015. Report model-specific results. No confirmatory p-values; collapsed or wide intervals do not establish robustness.
eligibility: Oracle relevance and report availability only; never model correctness. Missing targets remain explicit and contrasts use common eligible cells.
fresh_execution: Narrow fresh-verification comparisons are diagnostic because both existing whole-live baselines failed competence. Different seeds/procedures/worker identifiers do not create new evidence sources. Witnesses are not measured unless explicitly emitted and checked.
independence: Worlds, renderings, repetition counts, architectures and policies from one base pair are dependent. Existing-world facts are a shared source.
